research_scope: mature official HGCN inference sampling hierarchy AND complete directed retrieval damage; no correction training or later stages

training.graph: full official-normalized adjacency after per-batch target bidirectional mask
training.initial_full_valid: learning diagnostic only, excluded from best selection
training.selection: first strict maximum complete original filtered micro-MRR; no sampled outputs in selection
training.save: best weights+matching native full points/ranks; last and batch/RNG history
training.resume: no automatic resume/extension; preserve failure, diagnose and review bounded repair
training.batch_rng: CPU torch.Generator, training seed+1; randperm of fixed positive query groups each update
training.initialization_rng: numpy and torch manual_seed(training seed), fresh weights
training.post_selection_acceptance: independent full4096/scheduled complete valid, matching best reload, learning state and fixed full hierarchy review before per-model eval release; exact training run/checkpoint/review hashes bound

official_task.best_selection: strict val average(ROC,AP) only; test report after best reload
official_task.negative_pool: faithful upstream nonedges + heldout val/test positive edge pairs; explicit boundary, not WordNet protocol
official_task.driver_differences: preserve Slurm binding; save matching best weights/embeddings and last, no final-weight/best-embedding mismatch
official_task.claim_scope: single seed1234 modern-runtime official example check, not paper ten-seed mean

sampling.graphs_per_sample: two independent layer plans; only nonself uniform without replacement; HT weights
sampling.seed_formula: 202609190000 + training_seed*10000 + repeat*100 + fanout; full uses deterministic no-consumption generator

hierarchy.panel_rule: existing make_panels(view,target=1000), development panel; all existing pool/degree/relation seeds unchanged
hierarchy.label_scope: train+valid development DAG only; no test/truth
hierarchy.anchor: outcome-independent largest-descendant zero-indegree development root; FIXED full root native point
hierarchy.primary: direct exact-gap child-macro ordering, half credit exact ties, fixed inverse-inclusion child weights normalized over fixed covered children
hierarchy.secondary: distant ordering/gaps/flips/numerically unresolved mass/root unknown and weighted coverage
hierarchy.geometry: FP64 metrics on saved native FP32 Ball points; stable asinh distance and orthonormal fixed-F-point Log; no clipping/reprojection/old radius<=3 guard
hierarchy.near_zero_rule: unresolved secondary diagnostic only; does not rewrite primary exact-sign metric
hierarchy.full_premise: Full direct order >0.5 is necessary, NOT sufficient: review order/gaps/coverage and learning state before each sampling release. Report both seeds and all comparisons; no effect-based model exclusion or collapse claim from tiny significance.

bias.population: same outcome-independent selected 1000-child node panel; fixed per-node full base points
bias.error: orthonormal Log at F_i of S_ri in FP64; basis fixed per node across 16 repeats
bias.mean_vector: save sample mean vector and norm; alone NOT evidence of systematic bias
bias.centered_variance: mean_r ||e_ri-mean_i||^2, denominator R; MSE = this + ||mean_i||^2 is algebraic identity
bias.direction: predefined outward unit = -orthonormal Log_Fi(full-root)/D(Fi,full-root); missing/nearzero direction retained as unknown
bias.radial_projection: repeat aggregate inverse-probability weighted signed outward projections, fixed known-direction denominator; conditional marginal t95 CI exploratory only
bias.claims: nonzero sample mean/norm is not bias proof; damage is not mean-causal proof; no replacement for Holm12 primary outcomes

statistics.unit: independent complete graph replicate, spatial covariance retained by repeat aggregation
statistics.comparisons: 2 fixed train seeds x 3 sampled budgets x direct order/micro-MRR, S-F
statistics.CI: two-sided marginal Student95, not simultaneous CI
statistics.p: two-sided Student test of zero conditional mean; Holm all12 at alpha .05
statistics.zero_variance: no rejection, p1, undefined t/CI retained null
statistics.generality: conditional on two trained checkpoints/graph/valid development view; not training-population or test/architecture-wide proof

stopping.integrity: any source/config/weight/array/probability/coverage/finite mismatch fails gate and preserves evidence
stopping.training_completion: all4096 and scheduled complete rankings required; partial/wall-limited model is not accepted mature baseline
stopping.sampling_completion: all16 x all budgets x both seeds and full replay required; no optional stopping
stopping.numerics: default double() changes official projection eps; no claim of pure encoder roundoff from default double replay
stopping.scientific_conclusion: joint decline requires interpretable F plus paired primary effects/intervals; negative/one-outcome/premise-insufficient results retained
stopping.end: stop after independent archive/rank/statistics acceptance and discuss correction plan

resources.accounting: conservative actual ACL allocation/step seconds, failed attempts included; no default extension/reallocation; only ready jobs reserve resources

ranking.full_replay: native FP32 points exact; rows compared by query identity, not positional zip; metrics recomputed

quality_evidence.scope: previous quality19 source compatibility and cost only; new science source requires own CPU/CUDA fixtures
